plugin.name: BREAKBEAT
plugin.description: schwung-breakbeat slicer with BBCut cut procedures (CutProc11, WarpCut, SQPusher1, ChooseCut), loop A/B phrase, retriggers, cut display

Slicer: Complexity (BBCut: roll / repeat chance, SQPUSHER1 activity)
Roll (MOVE: stay on a slice; BBCut: roll shape)
B chance (the fill bar plays loop B)
Retrig: Scramble (BBCut: blocks from a random eighth)
Gate (part of each hit at full level)
Mode: Cut mode (MOVE / CUTPROC11 / WARPCUT / SQPUSHER1 / CHOOSECUT)
Run (internal clock when CLK is not patched)
Inputs: Slice (1/12 V per slice from 0 V; unpatched = next slice)
Outputs: Slice of the last hit (1/12 V per slice)
